purpose: Reconcile dimension statements and dimensional relations into a provenance-aware set of accepted, derived, conflicting, and unresolved values.
trigger: Multiple views, notes, source artifacts, or user constraints contain dimensional statements that must be compared before a geometry contract is handed downstream.

inputs.name: dimension_statements
inputs.description: Observed or user-supplied values, units, tolerances, scope, and source locators; each statement retains observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance.

inputs.name: geometry_observations
inputs.description: Geometry primitives, features, and relations that identify what each dimensional statement refers to without relying on product-specific labels.

inputs.name: user_constraints
inputs.type: optional user-supplied dimensional constraints and priorities
inputs.description: User input used to resolve precedence or tolerance policy; it remains distinct from observed and inferred values.

preconditions: Each dimension statement has a readable source locator or is explicitly marked as user input.
Units, reference features, and scope are recorded when known; unknown context remains unresolved instead of receiving a default.
The operation is limited to reconciling dimensional information and does not define a coordinate frame, construction order, or application operation.

outputs.name: dimensions_with_provenance
outputs.description: Accepted and derived dimensional values with units, tolerance, scope, source support, and explicit observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance.

outputs.name: dimension_relations
outputs.description: Equality, difference, ratio, dependency, or reference relations used in reconciliation, including rationale and source support.

outputs.name: unresolved_items
outputs.description: Conflicting units, scope, tolerance, or placement statements retained as unresolved items with the smallest clarification needed.

outputs.name: reconciliation_confidence
outputs.description: Confidence and rationale for each accepted or derived value, including uncertainty caused by inference or unresolved source evidence.

postconditions: Every retained or derived value records units, reference scope, source support, and an observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance tag.
Conflicting or incomparable statements remain visible as unresolved; no silent default, forced conversion, or priority is introduced.
Dimensional relations are traceable to the statements that support them and do not alter geometry or choose a construction sequence.
The output exposes confidence and clarification needs for the downstream geometry contract.

implementation.target_environment: Visual/text reasoning only; no SpaceClaim runtime or application control.
implementation.notes: No standalone implementation artifact is published; this candidate is a contract-bound reasoning boundary assembled from linked general reference guidance.

ambiguity_checks: No application geometry is selected; dimension references are matched to case-neutral feature descriptions and source locators.
Audit every value and relation for observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance, including unit and scope context.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable because the operation does not create or modify geometry topology.

failure_modes.condition: A dimensional statement does not identify the referenced feature, extent, or view scope well enough for comparison.
failure_modes.detection: Check each statement for feature reference, scope, unit context, and source locator before reconciliation.
failure_modes.safe_state: Keep the statement unresolved and do not emit it as an accepted dimension.

failure_modes.condition: Two or more supported statements conflict beyond their declared tolerance or cannot be safely compared.
failure_modes.detection: Compare normalized values only when units and scope are compatible and retain each mismatch with its sources.
failure_modes.safe_state: Preserve all conflicting statements as unresolved and withhold a ready handoff.

failure_modes.condition: A value, conversion, relation, or precedence decision cannot be labeled as observation, user, inference, or unresolved.
failure_modes.detection: Run a provenance completeness audit over the reconciled table and relation list.
failure_modes.safe_state: Mark the affected result unresolved and make no automatic acceptance decision.

recovery.action: Add the smallest missing feature, view, unit, or source locator and rerun reconciliation.
Request clarification or an explicit user precedence/tolerance rule, then rerun from the original statements.
Restore source or user provenance for the affected value and rerun the completeness audit.

validation.method: Review the template against the geometry-understanding stage contract and linked general guidance.
validation.expected: The operation reconciles dimension statements only; it does not extract unrelated geometry, define a frame, or run an application.

validation.method: Inspect input/output declarations, postconditions, failure modes, and recovery for observation, user, inference, and unresolved paths.
validation.expected: Accepted, derived, conflicting, and missing values retain explicit provenance and no unmarked default or conversion is introduced.

validation.method: Review identifiers, wording, artifact links, and evidence states for case-specific names, private data, numeric examples, and unsupported runtime claims.
validation.expected: The template is reusable across source types and claims design intent only.

validation.method: Validate accepted, conflicting, derived, and deliberately invalid dimension outputs with the bound host checker.
validation.expected: Resolved values require units, derivations are explicit, conflicts remain linked to unresolved items, and blocking uncertainty cannot be marked ready.

evidence_refs.notes: Public design-only review record for this exact candidate template version.

design_only.notes: Atomicity, provenance separation, case neutrality, and the no-runtime boundary were reviewed.

evidence_refs.notes: Host-only schema and neutral fixture check for this exact candidate version.

host_checked.notes: The bound host checker passed structural and deterministic fixture invariants; it did not evaluate unseen-source dimension reading or scoping accuracy.

spaceclaim_execution.notes: This operation does not launch or control SpaceClaim.

geometry_measurements.notes: No model is measured; dimensional statements are reconciled as source data only.

visual_review.notes: This is source-data reconciliation, not final viewport or image acceptance.

evidence_level.notes: Evidence stops at design_only and host_checked; unseen-source reconciliation accuracy and all application, measurement, persistence, visual-acceptance, and export layers remain unclaimed.
